name: feroxbuster
summary: A fast, simple, recursive content discovery tool written in Rust.
highlights: --resume-from — State file from which to resume a partially complete scan (ex. --resume-from ferox-1606586
--request-file — Raw HTTP request file to use as a template for all requests
--burp — Set --proxy to http://127.0.0.1:8080 and set --insecure to true
--burp-replay — Set --replay-proxy to http://127.0.0.1:8080 and set --insecure to true

flags.name: --help
flags.description: Print help (see a summary with '-h')

flags.name: --version
flags.description: Print version

flags.name: --url
flags.description: The target URL (required, unless [--stdin || --resume-from || --request-file] used)

flags.name: --stdin
flags.description: Read url(s) from STDIN

flags.name: --resume-from
flags.description: State file from which to resume a partially complete scan (ex. --resume-from ferox-1606586780.state)

flags.name: --request-file
flags.description: Raw HTTP request file to use as a template for all requests

flags.name: --burp
flags.description: Set --proxy to http://127.0.0.1:8080 and set --insecure to true

flags.name: --burp-replay
flags.description: Set --replay-proxy to http://127.0.0.1:8080 and set --insecure to true

flags.name: --data-urlencoded
flags.description: Set -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded', --data to <data-urlencoded> (supports @file) and -m to POST

flags.name: --data-json
flags.description: Set -H 'Content-Type: application/json', --data to <data-json> (supports @file) and -m to POST

flags.name: --smart
flags.description: Set --auto-tune, --collect-words, and --collect-backups to true

flags.name: --thorough
flags.description: Use the same settings as --smart and set --collect-extensions and --scan-dir-listings to true

flags.name: --proxy
flags.description: Proxy to use for requests (ex: http(s)://host:port, socks5(h)://host:port)

flags.name: --replay-proxy
flags.description: Send only unfiltered requests through a Replay Proxy, instead of all requests

flags.name: --user-agent
flags.description: Sets the User-Agent (default: feroxbuster/2.13.1)

flags.name: --random-agent
flags.description: Use a random User-Agent

flags.name: --data
flags.description: Request's Body; can read data from a file if input starts with an @ (ex: @post.bin)

flags.name: --add-slash
flags.description: Append / to each request's URL

flags.name: --protocol
flags.description: Specify the protocol to use when targeting via --request-file or --url with domain only (default: https)

flags.name: --unique
flags.description: Only show unique responses

flags.name: --timeout
flags.description: Number of seconds before a client's request times out (default: 7)

flags.name: --redirects
flags.description: Allow client to follow redirects

flags.name: --insecure
flags.description: Disables TLS certificate validation in the client

flags.name: --client-cert
flags.description: Add a PEM encoded certificate for mutual authentication (mTLS)

flags.name: --client-key
flags.description: Add a PEM encoded private key for mutual authentication (mTLS)

flags.name: --threads
flags.description: Number of concurrent threads (default: 50)

flags.name: --no-recursion
flags.description: Do not scan recursively

flags.name: --depth
flags.description: Maximum recursion depth, a depth of 0 is infinite recursion (default: 4)

flags.name: --force-recursion
flags.description: Force recursion attempts on all 'found' endpoints (still respects recursion depth)

flags.name: --dont-extract-links
flags.description: Don't extract links from response body (html, javascript, etc...)

flags.name: --scan-limit
flags.description: Limit total number of concurrent scans (default: 0, i.e. no limit)

flags.name: --parallel
flags.description: Run parallel feroxbuster instances (one child process per url passed via stdin)

flags.name: --rate-limit
flags.description: Limit number of requests per second (per directory) (default: 0, i.e. no limit)

flags.name: --response-size-limit
flags.description: Limit size of response body to read in bytes (default: 4MB)

flags.name: --time-limit
flags.description: Limit total run time of all scans (ex: --time-limit 10m)

flags.name: --wordlist
flags.description: Path or URL of the wordlist

flags.name: --auto-tune
flags.description: Automatically lower scan rate when an excessive amount of errors are encountered

flags.name: --auto-bail
flags.description: Automatically stop scanning when an excessive amount of errors are encountered

flags.name: --dont-filter
flags.description: Don't auto-filter wildcard responses

flags.name: --scan-dir-listings
flags.description: Force scans to recurse into directory listings

flags.name: --collect-extensions
flags.description: Automatically discover extensions and add them to --extensions (unless they're in --dont-collect)

flags.name: --collect-backups
flags.description: Automatically request likely backup extensions for "found" urls (default: ~, .bak, .bak2, .old, .1)

flags.name: --collect-words
flags.description: Automatically discover important words from within responses and add them to the wordlist

flags.name: --verbosity
flags.description: Increase verbosity level (use -vv or more for greater effect. [CAUTION] 4 -v's is probably too much)

flags.name: --silent
flags.description: Only print URLs (or JSON w/ --json) + turn off logging (good for piping a list of urls to other commands)

flags.name: --quiet
flags.description: Hide progress bars and banner (good for tmux windows w/ notifications)

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Emit JSON logs to --output and --debug-log instead of normal text

flags.name: --output
flags.description: Output file to write results to (use w/ --json for JSON entries)

flags.name: --debug-log
flags.description: Output file to write log entries (use w/ --json for JSON entries)

flags.name: --no-state
flags.description: Disable state output file (*.state)

flags.name: --limit-bars
flags.description: Number of directory scan bars to show at any given time (default: no limit)

flags.name: --update
flags.description: Update feroxbuster to the latest version

examples.explanation: Enumerate directories without recursion through a specific proxy
